notes: Candidate-only selection. Exclusions and interactions derive from current original EXE English descriptions; no in-game run, legality test or DPS numbers.

build_experiments.name: Lesser demon stream (stationary research)
build_experiments.hypothesis: Frequent temporary lesser demons and permanent Imp could improve area clearing when standing still. Requires live verification of spawn timing, number caps, card availability and boss damage.

build_experiments.name: Permanent greater demons (stationary research)
build_experiments.hypothesis: Permanent major demons may reduce re-summon downtime, but Supremacy disables lesser demons. Bench sustained damage, minion uptime, survivability and Boss DPS.
